Run paw Harbor benchmark sweeps

Usage:
  paw bench [flags]

Flags:
      --agent-import-path string   Harbor agent import path (default "paw_harbor:PawAgent")
      --config string              benchmark config: full, no-compress, raw (default "full")
      --dataset string             Harbor dataset (default "terminal-bench@2.0")
      --dry-run                    print Harbor command without running it
      --harbor-bin string          Harbor executable (default "harbor")
  -h, --help                       help for bench
      --job-name string            Harbor job name
      --jobs-dir string            Harbor jobs directory (default ".paw/bench-jobs")
      --model string               Harbor model (default "openai/glm-4.6")
      --n-attempts int             optional Harbor attempts per task
      --n-concurrent int           Harbor concurrency (default 4)
      --n-tasks int                optional Harbor task subset size
      --results-file string        results markdown file to update (default "docs/RESULTS.md")

Global Flags:
      --no-color            disable colored stderr output
      --trace-file string   trace file
      --verbose             verbose output
